Package com.sca4d.openapi.web

Class OpenApiCachedBodyHttpServletRequest

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.ServletRequestWrapper
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequestWrapper
com.sca4d.openapi.web.OpenApiCachedBodyHttpServletRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest, jakarta.servlet.ServletRequest
public final class OpenApiCachedBodyHttpServletRequest extends jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequestWrapper
保存 OpenAPI 请求体，使 HMAC 校验读取后 Spring 仍能绑定同一份请求体。
